# Pull Request

## Why

Describe the problem and why this change is needed.

## What Changed

- Summarize the minimal implementation.

## Verification

List the exact checks run and their results. Note any external dependency that
could not be verified.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves public compatibility, or a breaking
      change is clearly identified.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior and relevant failure paths.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm run format:check`, and
      `npm test` pass.
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when user-facing behavior
      changes.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or personal information are included.
